This is an empty process because of the cut-off at recycling. The recycling benefit and costs are allocated to the production of the recycled PET. To include this benefit and cost the following data should be included: Polyethylene terephthalate, granulate, bottle grade should be used as avoided product and 0,6 kWh electricity medium voltage should be used as input from technosphere. These are rough estimates and should not be used if recycling is important.
